prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent mascot cutout for the welcome and home hero of a multiplication adventure PWA for a 10-year-old child.
Primary request: Create ONE polished original friendly astronaut robot explorer, confident and charming, adventure-minded rather than preschool.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with a clean alpha cutout. No scene, floor, vignette, orbit, stars, halo, or shadow baked into the background.
Subject: small rounded mint/teal robot astronaut with an oversized dark navy glass face, two friendly softly luminous mint eyes, and a subtle happy expression. Pale warm cream space suit with neat coral-orange and sunny yellow accents; compact rounded boots; tiny coral-orange backpack with a tiny soft flame hint visible behind it. One mitten-shaped hand waves hello, the other arm relaxed. Full body gently floating diagonally with a slight 10-degree tilt.
Style/medium: premium handmade soft 3D clay toy illustration; carefully modeled sculptural forms with restrained detail; delightful tactile satin material, beautifully finished, no brand imitation.
Composition/framing: single isolated complete character, three-quarter view, centered in a square canvas with generous transparent margins and an easily readable silhouette. Keep waving fingertips, boots and backpack entirely inside frame.
Lighting/mood: gentle warm studio key light and soft cool fill light, subtle ambient shading on the character, bright welcoming mood.
Color palette: mint #8de2ca and teal for robot shell; deep navy #18213a glass face; pale warm cream suit; accents coral #ff8e6b and sun #ffd166; very subtle lilac #b9a5fa reflections. Designed to look beautiful on warm lavender #f5f3ff UI.
Constraints: original character, no text, no logos, no watermark, no baked-in UI or background, preserve real transparency; not a copy of an existing mascot. No intimidating expression, weapons, sharp edges, or babyish proportions. Character is the only subject.
